concept.electronegativity.excerpt: The ability of an atom in a molecule to attract shared electrons is called electronegativity

concept.bondByDifference.excerpt: If the difference between the electronegativities is large, the more electronegative atom will take the bonding electrons completely away from the other atom

concept.saltLattice.excerpt: Likewise, six sodium ions immediately surround each chloride ion, making the coordination number of chloride also equal to 6.

concept.balanced.excerpt: Balanced chemical equations have the same number and type of each atom on both sides of the equation.
